name: EGG TOOTH
source:
in which a mech pilot struggles with being a component part, a mech bottoms, and an alien threat gets into a threesome.

[From [url=https://solflo.itch.io/egg-tooth]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个故事里，一名机甲驾驶员因沦为机体零件而苦苦挣扎，一台机甲在床笫间甘居下位，而某个外星威胁更是加入了这场三人行。

[摘自[url=https://solflo.itch.io/egg-tooth]itch.io[/url]]
